name: Shinji (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shinji town emblem in white: an outlined stylised device of curved strokes and horizontal bars.
history: Flag of the former town of Shinji in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-31. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 November 1975.

features.role: Shinji town emblem — an outlined stylised device of curved strokes and horizontal bars
